## Activity

During December 2025, East City Eye Clinic recorded 202 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The recorded activity should be considered alongside the results that could be assessed and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.0. This indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues continue to be logged with the service desk so that any equipment or image-capture concerns can be followed up.

## Grading

There were 60 referable results during December 2025. The median grading lag was 3. This measure provides an overview of the time between image capture and completion of grading. The clinic should continue to monitor grading timeliness alongside the number of referable results and the ungradable rate, using the monthly findings to identify any recurring operational issues.
